components.css: .ds-disclosure{font-family:Heebo,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#332a20);border-bottom:1px solid #cbbca8}.ds-disclosure summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding-block:17px;font-size:19px}.ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-disclosure summary svg{transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-disclosure[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-disclosure[open] p{animation:ds-disclosure-open 220ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both}.ds-disclosure p{color:#665744;padding-bottom:20px;max-width:450px;line-height:1.8}.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#526047);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-disclosure summary svg{transition:none}}@keyframes ds-disclosure-open{from{opacity:.6;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-disclosure[open] p{animation:none}}

narrative.overview: The approved wood design now defines `/`. This directory implements that homepage and the unindexed `/wood-preview/` alias; it is not a separate visual identity. [Root DESIGN.md](../../DESIGN.md) is the normative source for colors, typography, spacing, shapes, components, motion and accessibility. [Root .impeccable/design.json](../../.impeccable/design.json) carries the current component samples and extensions.
keyCharacteristics: One canonical cream, walnut and olive system shared with the homepage.
An additional utility toolbar only on the preview alias.
The same room assembly, animated fallback, catalog and recognizable logo.
dos: **Do** apply the root wood system to both `/` and `/wood-preview/`.
**Do** keep the preview alias unindexed and account for its extra toolbar.
**Do** preserve the root motion controls, reduced-motion presentation and animated WebGL fallback.
donts: **Don't** restore the former prohibition against using this system on the homepage.
**Don't** maintain independent palette or component rules that drift from the root canon.
